# 2026-10-11 metrics: 3,000-book rescoring

Metrics use base-2 logarithms. Item/edge score CIs and query CIs use 1,000 shared resamples; permutation CIs bootstrap the 200 shuffled assignments. The theoretical entropy and alphabetic bounds condition on the ordered leaf distribution. Zipf popularity uses s=1, seed 20261010. Popularity proxy: none; sampled book data has one edition per work and no edition-count values.
